'''Gregory Z. Gutin''' ({{Langx|he|גרגורי גוטין}}; born 17 January 1957) is a scholar in theoretical computer science and discrete mathematics. He received his PhD in Mathematics in 1993 from [[Tel Aviv University]] under the supervision of [[Noga Alon]]. Since September 2000 Gutin has been Professor in [[Computer Science]] at [[Royal Holloway, University of London]]. In 2024 he was appointed Distinguished Scientist at the Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology for the period 2024–2026.<ref>{{cite web |title=Algorithms and Applications Research Center Members |url=https://hpcc.siat.ac.cn/algorithms/member.html |website=Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology |publisher=Chinese Academy of Sciences |access-date=17 September 2025}}</ref>

Gutin's research interests are in algorithms and complexity, [[access control]], [[graph theory]], [[game theory]] and [[combinatorial optimization]].

==Awards and honours==
Gutin was the recipient of the [[Royal Society Wolfson Research Merit Award]] in 2014,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/gregory-gutin-7115/ |title=Gregory Gutin |publisher=Royal Society |date= |access-date=2017-07-10}}</ref> and the best paper awards at SACMAT 2015,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sacmat.org/2015/index.php |title=Symposium on Access control Models and Technologies |website=Sacmat.org |date= |access-date=2017-07-10}}</ref> 2016,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sacmat.org/2016/index.php |title=Symposium on Access control Models and Technologies |website=Sacmat.org |date= |access-date=2017-07-10}}</ref>
2021<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sacmat.dista.uninsubria.it/2021/ |title=Symposium on Access control Models and Technologies |website=Sacmat.org |date= |access-date=2022-03-21}}</ref> and 2022.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.acm.org/conferences/best-paper-awards-2022 |title=ACM Best Paper Awards – SACMAT 2022 |website=Association for Computing Machinery |access-date=17 September 2025}}</ref>  In January 2017 there was a workshop celebrating Gutin's 60th birthday.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://gutin60.ma.rhul.ac.uk/ |title=Gregory Gutin's 60th Birthday ConferenceGregory Gutin's 60th Birthday Conference &#124; January 7th & 8th 2017 |website=Gutin60.ma.rhul.ac.uk |date=2017-01-08 |access-date=2017-07-10}}</ref> In 2017, he became a member of [[Academia Europaea]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Gutin_Gregory |title=G. Gutin's Academia Europaea webpage}}</ref>
